faq.question: Are these work areas separate service packages?
faq.answer: No. They are examples of checks or research that can be included when relevant. Start with a technical audit, keyword research or SEO consultation; the actual scope, deliverables and terms are agreed for each project.

faq.question: What affects the cost and delivery time?
faq.answer: Site size, number of URLs and templates, target markets, data quality, available access, reporting depth and who implements fixes all affect a quote and schedule. The catalogue is not a fixed-price offer; specific deliverables and terms must be agreed before work begins.

faq.question: Is implementation included with an audit?
faq.answer: Not automatically. Diagnosis, development and verification are separate responsibilities. Access, implementation steps and deliverables require agreement.

faq.question: Can SEO work guarantee rankings, rich results or AI citations?
faq.answer: No. Search systems determine indexing and presentation. We can identify issues, propose fixes and evaluate evidence, but cannot guarantee inclusion, placement or traffic.

faq.question: Do you offer artificial authority-building packages?
faq.answer: No. Automated placements, purchased links intended to manipulate rankings, link networks and manufactured authority metrics are excluded. Ethical editorial outreach planning never guarantees third-party coverage.
